capability: Evaluate and improve agentic workflow reliability using traces, eval datasets, and quality thresholds.
assessment_signal: Eval plan, trace review, failure analysis, and reliability threshold rationale.
gap_hypothesis: Builder talent without eval and observability evidence will be harder to place into enterprise AI workflow roles.

capability: Connect models, APIs, data stores, and governance constraints into production-oriented AI workflows.
assessment_signal: Architecture decision record, integration prototype, and tradeoff explanation.
gap_hypothesis: Scaler talent needs integration evidence to match client demand for production AI readiness.

capability: Reason about data flow, privacy risk, and control points in regulated AI systems.
assessment_signal: Risk notes, simulation decisions, mitigations, and client-safe explanation.
gap_hypothesis: Regulated-client placements will need stronger proof of AI risk and privacy judgment.

capability: Build multimodal product prototypes that combine modalities in a useful workflow.
assessment_signal: Prototype artifact, modality choice rationale, and user workflow demo.
gap_hypothesis: Prototype portfolios that stay text-only may underperform against richer product workflow demand.

capability: Maintain prompt and workflow assets as part of broader AI product quality practice.
assessment_signal: Evidence should appear inside broader workflow quality tasks, not as a standalone credential yet.
gap_hypothesis: Prompt asset maintenance may matter as embedded practice, but current evidence does not justify a dedicated module.
